user.title: Count toilet flushes
user.description: Counts toilet flushes from a temperature probe immersed in the toilet bowl. A flush is a drop towards the mains water temperature of at least min(amplitude, share × available gap), where the available gap is the calm bowl temperature minus the lowest temperature of the last hours. Litres = flushes × volume per flush × calibration.

data.source_sensor: Temperature probe in the toilet bowl
data.start_threshold: Start threshold (°C away from the calm value)
data.min_amplitude: Amplitude to count a flush, upper bound (°C)
data.gap_fraction: Share of the available gap required
